applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Germany–China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 30 January 2003, entered into force 11 November 2005)
Germany–US Income Tax Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (signed 29 August 1989, as amended by Protocol of 17 July 2006)
Germany–India Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (signed 19 October 1995, as amended by Protocol of 2 July 2006)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: German Anti-Money Laundering Act (Geldwäschegesetz – GwG) of 23 June 2017 (BGBl. I S. 1822), as last amended by the Transparenzregister- und Finanzinformationsgesetz (TraFinG) of 12 August 2021 (BGBl. I S. 3131); UBO identification and transparency register obligations under §§ 20–21 GwG, defining beneficial owners pursuant to § 3(2) GwG in implementation of Directive (EU) 2018/843.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of shareholder's passport or national identity document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport/ID issuing authority of the shareholder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if jurisdiction is a Hague Convention member) OR Consular Legalization at the competent German consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address of shareholder/UBO (bank statement or utility bill)
Beneficial owner declaration and foreign registry extract (if UBO is a legal entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent foreign commercial registry or corporate register
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial certification followed by Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, and UBOs against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the United Nations Security Council Sanctions Lists, the German national embargo list maintained by the Bundesanzeiger, and the OFAC SDN List where USD-denominated settlement or correspondent banking is anticipated. PEP identification is required under § 6 GwG; enhanced due diligence is triggered for PEPs or high-risk third countries pursuant to § 15(3) GwG. Screening results must be documented and retained for five years as per § 8 GwG.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Unternehmensregister (www.unternehmensregister.de), operated pursuant to §§ 9 et seq. Gesetz über elektronische Handelsregister und Genossenschaftsregister sowie das Unternehmensregister (EHUG); actual name reservation and registration occurs at the competent local commercial register (Handelsregister) through the relevant Amtsgericht (district court).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be written in Latin script using German-language conventions; German umlauts (ä, ö, ü) and ß are permitted. Foreign-language names and alphabets must be transliterated into Latin characters for registry indexing if they contain non-Latin symbols. The name must be distinguishable from existing registered companies and not misleading under §§ 18, 30 Handelsgesetzbuch (HGB) and the general civil name-protection principles. The statutory suffix 'Unternehmergesellschaft (haftungsbeschränkt)' or the approved abbreviation 'UG (haftungsbeschränkt)' must be included in the firm name in accordance with § 5a GmbHG.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the competent Amtsgericht rejects a proposed name, the applicant (acting through the notary) may file an Erinnerung (remedy) against the decision with the same Amtsgericht within one month. If the Erinnerung is dismissed, a formal Beschwerde (complaint) may be lodged with the competent Landgericht (state district court). Further review in legal matters is available to the Oberlandesgericht (Higher Regional Court) by way of Rechtsbeschwerde. A rejected name may be resubmitted after correction of the conflict or misleading-character issue. Name reservations may be extended prior to expiry by notarial application, provided the registration process is demonstrably underway.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permissible. A UG must have a domestic business address (Geschäftsanschrift) in Germany at which official summons and court documents can be served and which is recorded in the Commercial Register. Virtual-office arrangements are acceptable only if the service provider supplies a genuine physical German street address, retains and forwards correspondence, allows compliance authorities to access records, and the company can prove actual substance. Purely postal-only or letterbox arrangements without access and management presence are rejected by German courts and the Trade Office as abusive.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 2% annual probability for low-risk standard commercial manufacturing businesses (ISIC 2740 / NAICS 335122) lacking statutory licensing requirements; this probability is applied internally based on Germany's federal risk classification and the documented absence of external AML triggers.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed AML compliance service provider or regulated corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for EU-standard AML/UBO verification; approx. EUR 300 per individual

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial name reservation declaration and simultaneous draft of the UG articles of association (Mustersatzung) under § 5a GmbHG
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: German Court and Notary Fees Act (GNotKG) §§ 40, 46; statutory minimum tariff based on minimum nominal capital of EUR 1

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Authentication bundle: notarization, apostille/consular legalization of three foreign investor documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Apostille authority of the issuing foreign state, consular receiver, or German certification office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Apostille Convention tariff benchmark of EUR 25–30 per document; consular legalization at parity where non-Hague states apply

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Provisional registered business address (Geschäftsanschrift) service for three months
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial co-working or business-service provider offering service of process capability
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for German virtual office with physical service-of-process address; approx. EUR 60 per month

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Official commercial-register name-clearance search and distinction check (Handelsregister/Unternehmensregister)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory fee for public name-search and distinction inquiries where performed via the public online register

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: German Limited Liability Companies Act (Gesetz betreffend die Gesellschaften mit beschränkter Haftung, GmbHG), including § 5a on the Unternehmergesellschaft (haftungsbeschränkt); Commercial Code (HGB) §§ 8-16 on Commercial Register filing; Industrial Code (Gewerbeordnung) § 14 on trade notification
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Commercial Register (Handelsregister) administered by the competent Local Court (Amtsgericht); electronic filing is effected exclusively by a certified German notary
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Articles of Association (Gesellschaftsvertrag / Musterprotokoll) together with the Registration Application (Anmeldung zur Eintragung), Shareholder List, and managing director's specimen signature
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum share capital is EUR 1.00; the subscribed capital must be fully paid in before registration, either in cash or in-kind, and the managing director must confirm that the funds are at the company's free disposal. No statutory escrow (Treuhandkonto) is mandated for cash contributions; a German bank account in the company's name is sufficient. The UG must add the suffix 'haftungsbeschränkt' to its name, and an annual reserve equal to 25% of net profit must be accumulated until the share capital reaches EUR 25,000.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: 1. SUBSCRIPTION OF SHARES. The sole shareholder subscribes to the entire share capital of the Unternehmergesellschaft (haftungsbeschränkt) and confirms the subscribed capital is fully paid into the company bank account and freely at the disposal of the managing director. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE. The registered office is adopted at [street address], Germany. 3. APPOINTMENT. [Name] is appointed sole managing director with sole-signature authority, exempted from the restrictions of § 181 BGB vis-à-vis the shareholder. 4. GOVERNANCE. Formation costs, notarial expenses and incidental charges are assumed by the company. 5. FILING. The managing director is instructed to file for Commercial Register registration, trade registration, tax registration, and all industrial producer registrations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarial Execution of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founding shareholder appears personally before the notary; the notary reads and certifies the Articles of Association (Musterprotokoll for a simple UG), the shareholder list, and the specimen signature of the managing director. Identity is verified against the passport; the notary issues the notarized instrument and files the application electronically with the Commercial Register upon completion of subsequent steps.
required_dossiers: Valid passport or national ID of the founding shareholder
Proposed registered office street address and confirmation of landlord consent
Details of any in-kind contribution (Sacheinlage) with valuation report, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary detects deficiencies in the articles (e.g., inaccurate capital or business purpose), the instrument is corrected and re-executed in the same session; a second appointment is required only if a new shareholder joins the formation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening Bank Account and Payment of Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: German private bank or licensed fintech partner (e.g., Commerzbank, Deutsche Bank, Airwallex) offering corporate accounts for pre-registration UGs
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the notarized draft articles and personal identification to the bank; complete KYC/UBO declarations; open the company account in the name of 'UG (haftungsbeschränkt) i.G.'; transfer the subscribed share capital; obtain a written funds-confirmation from the bank that the deposit is at the managing director's free disposal.
required_dossiers: Passport of managing director and beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the account application, provide enhanced source-of-funds documentation or select an alternative bank; if no bank will open a pre-registration account, the notary may establish an official escrow sub-account (Anderkonto) to receive the contribution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Register Filing and Legal Personality
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Handelsregister department of the competent Local Court (Amtsgericht), filed electronically by the notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary submits the notarized Anmeldung, Articles of Association, shareholder list, managing director's specimen signature, and the declaration on the free disposal of the share capital to the electronic Commercial Register. The court verifies legal compliance and, upon approval, issues the registration entry; the UG acquires independent legal personality with the suffix 'haftungsbeschränkt'.
required_dossiers: List of shareholders and subscribed capital amounts
Funds-confirmation or bank statement evidencing payment of capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the court issues an objection notice (Zwischenverfügung) identifying formal defects, counsel or the notary cures the defect within the stated deadline; no additional filing fee is charged for resubmission within the same proceeding.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Trade Office (Gewerbeamt / Ordnungsamt) at the municipality of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The managing director files the Gewerbeanmeldung under § 14 GewO in person or through the municipality's online portal, describing the business scope as 'manufacture and wholesale of commercial agricultural full-spectrum LED fixtures'. The trade office issues the registration certificate (Gewerbeanmeldungsbestätigung) and automatically forwards the data to the tax office, the Chamber of Industry and Commerce (IHK), the statistical office, and the employer's liability insurance association.
required_dossiers: Commercial Register extract or provisional registration number
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the trade office queries the business description as being too broad, the managing director submits an amended form narrowing the scope to ISIC 2740 manufacturing; the certificate is reissued without penalty; a fine may be imposed only if the activity has been operated without notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Tax Office (Finanzamt) through the automatic tax server; Federal Central Tax Office (Bundeszentralamt für Steuern, BZSt) for VAT ID; Stiftung Elektro-Altgeräte Register (stiftung ear) for WEEE producer registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of the trade registration data, the Finanzamt issues the tax number and the tax registration questionnaire (Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung); the managing director files the questionnaire, including projected turnover. Simultaneously, the application for the EU VAT identification number (USt-IdNr.) is submitted to BZSt, and the company registers as a producer of electrical and electronic equipment with stiftung ear under § 6 ElektroG, including the appointment of an authorized representative for distance selling if applicable.
required_dossiers: Tax registration questionnaire (Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung)
WEEE registration form with product categories (LED lighting devices) and insolvency-secured guarantee documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Finanzamt rejects the projected turnover or queries VAT treatment, the managing director submits revised projected figures; ear registration defects (e.g., missing guarantee) are cured through the ear online portal before market placement; late registration may trigger fines under ElektroG, so expedited filing is strongly advised.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Local Trade Office (Gewerbeamt), State Immission Control Authority, and Stiftung Elektro-Altgeräte Register (stiftung ear) for WEEE producer duties
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Gewerbeanmeldung under § 14 GewO for commercial manufacturing; Producer registration under § 6 ElektroG (WEEE) with annual sales-quantity reporting; no separate immission-control permit under 4. BImSchV is required for non-hazardous LED assembly operations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Federal Environment Agency (Umweltbundesamt, UBA) and local environmental office (Umweltamt)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not subject to EIA under Annex 1 of the Environmental Impact Assessment Act (UVPG); no federal immission-control permit (BImSchG) is required; only simple environmental notification and waste-registration duties apply
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the Water Resources Act (WHG) and Wastewater Ordinance (AbwV) — no process wastewater discharge from surface-mount technology (SMT) assembly lines; VOC exhaust concentration limit of 50 mg C/m³ under 31. BImSchV where cleaning or coating agents are used; WEEE take-back, recycling coordination, and registration duties per ElektroG; hazardous-waste segregation and documentation under the Circular Economy Act (KrWG) subject to local waste-authority supervision

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certificate (Brandschutznachweis) and first inspection by the local fire-prevention authority; structural-load approval for production racks and equipment per state building regulations (LBO); workplace safety audit under the Occupational Safety Act (ArbSchG) and DGUV Ordinance 1; mandatory registration with the employers' liability insurance association (Berufsgenossenschaft Elektro or Handel und Warenlogistik); occupational-medical care arrangement; ESD-control verification and lighting-level measurement for assembly workstations

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Deutsche Bundesbank (German Federal Bank), Frankfurt am Main; monetary policy is exercised through the Eurosystem/ECB, while the Bundesbank administers Germany's external-sector payment statistics and the Foreign Trade and Payments Ordinance (Außenwirtschaftsverordnung, AWV §§ 60-70) reporting regime. Banking conduct supervision is shared with the Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (BaFin).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible in both the current and capital accounts; no exchange-control licence, surrender obligation, or prior-authorization mechanism applies to commercial payments or capital flows. Restrictions arise only from EU/UN sanctions, national investment screening (Außenwirtschaftsgesetz §§ 5, 55-60), and prudential bank-side compliance. Profit remittance from a German UG is unrestricted in amount and currency, but non-resident dividend recipients are subject to German dividend withholding tax at the statutory rate of 25% plus 5.5% solidarity surcharge (plus church tax if applicable), potentially reduced under an applicable double-tax treaty or the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive; any payment into or out of Germany exceeding EUR 12,500 must be reported to the Deutsche Bundesbank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None; German law imposes no mandatory conversion of export receipts, and the UG may retain 100% of foreign-currency proceeds in its accounts. The only binding obligation is statistical: each receipt or payment for goods, services, or financial claims above EUR 12,500 (or the equivalent value on the value date) must be reported by the bank/exporter to the Deutsche Bundesbank within seven calendar days of the value date or, for receivables, within seven days of invoicing. No minimum conversion ratio applies.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: EUR operational account (Girokonto) with multi-currency overlay; trade-finance and cash-management account for cross-border settlement
EUR operational account and treasury/custody structure; segregated capital-escrow mandate where notary requires a Sperrkonto for capital-verification evidence
EUR operational account with integrated FX desk and cross-currency hedging overlay
Indirect corporate access via the cooperative-bank network (Volksbank/Raiffeisenbank) only; EUR operational account with statutory capital verification

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Acceptable only as an auxiliary collection and payment rail, not as the primary banking relationship. Passported EEA electronic-money institutions (e.g., Airwallex, Revolut Business, Qonto) may lawfully provide EUR IBANs to a German UG under PSD2 as implemented by the German Payment Services Supervision Act (ZAG); funds are safeguarded but are not covered by the statutory deposit-guarantee scheme, and significant concentration/third-party risk exists. An offshore EMI without an EEA licence or German agency cannot provide regulated payment accounts. The UG should maintain a German-licensed credit institution as the legal-entity bank for notarial free-disposal confirmation, tax authority communication, and commercial-register acceptance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A statutory requirement for all directors to appear physically does not exist; a German-resident Geschäftsführer may complete onboarding via compliant VideoIdent/PostIdent procedures. In practice, tier-1 traditional banks require one managing director or an appointed authorized signatory to attend an in-person interview and to present original commercial-register extract, USt-IdNr certificate, transparency-register confirmation, and proof of registered office. Non-EU/non-resident directors face a near-universal mandate for physical appearance or apostilled and sworn-translated notarial/certified copies, with bank-side field checks and sanctions screening extending total onboarding time to 2-4 weeks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident, non-EU shareholder with an indirect UBO chain and procurement from high-volume East Asian LED-supplier jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarially certified incorporation documents; shareholder register; transparency-register (Transparenzregister) UBO declaration; apostilled passports; bank statements evidencing source of funds of the shareholder; group structure chart; written confirmation that the shareholder is not subject to EU/OFAC sanctions; certified translations into German.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Freshly incorporated UG (haftungsbeschränkt) with minimum capital of EUR 1 and no audited financial history.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized deed and commercial-register excerpt; tax advisor's opening balance sheet (Eröffnungsbilanz); accountant's confirmation of paid-in capital and free disposal; 12-month forward-looking business plan with cash-flow forecasts; order backlog or letters of intent; signed AML risk assessment prepared in accordance with § 5 GwG.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Horticultural LED grow-light product profile considered one step removed from indoor cannabis cultivation, triggering heightened industry scrutiny.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Technical datasheets and CE/EMC declarations confirming use in commercial greenhouse and licensed agricultural facilities; B2B contracts with authorized agricultural distributors; end-user statements; written representation that the UG does not supply cannabis-related equipment; EORI registration and customs records evidencing ISIC 2740/NAICS 335122 classification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High cross-border payment velocity to Asian component suppliers inconsistent with declared staffing and physical footprint.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Trade-flow file comprising purchase orders, supplier invoices, bills of lading/airway bills, customs clearance certificates, Incoterms 2020 entries (FOB/CIF), commercial letters of credit or bank payment evidence; payroll and VAT returns; corporate income tax filings; supplier payment ledger for the prior two quarters.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Receipts routed through multiple e-commerce and fintech payment hubs (Airwallex, Shopify, Amazon) obscuring the identity of underlying commercial counterparties.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform payout statements and clearing reports; merchant registration and German USt-IdNr confirmation; country-level buyer and order-volume reports; marketplace seller policy attestation; order-level ledger exports; monthly reconciliation between platform gross receipts and booked sales revenue.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital injection is executed via SWIFT MT103 (or SEPA Credit Transfer within the EU/EEA) debited from an account beneficially owned exclusively by the shareholder. The remittance information must state 'Gesellschaftereinlage / Kapitalerhöhung' together with the notary file reference; SWIFT purpose code 'INTC' (intra-company) or an explicit 'EQUITY CONTRIBUTION' narrative is accepted by German booking systems. For any amount above EUR 12,500, the Bundesbank payment-statistics report (Zahlungsbilanzstatistik, form ZP, capital-investment category) must be filed within seven days. The receiving bank requires the notarized capital-contribution declaration and, for commercial-register registration, a free-disposal confirmation (Freistellungsbestätigung) issued by the account-holding bank after the funds are credited.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier and trade settlements are executed principally through SWIFT MT103 open-account credits in EUR or USD, cleared within the TARGET2/SEPA-EUR system or via CHIPS/Fedwire for USD; commercial letters of credit issued by MT700 and amended by MT707 (UCP600 rules) are the preferred rail for high-value East Asian LED-component purchases above USD 50,000, with documentary collection (DP/DA) as a secondary option. Every outgoing payment above EUR 12,500 is reported by the bank to the Bundesbank within seven days. FX conversion for trade payables is centralized on the UG's German bank FX desk to minimize float and comply with German Girokonto booking requirements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla deliverable EUR/USD forward with maturity up to 24 months, segregated against firm commercial exposure
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) referencing a non-convertible offshore currency (e.g., CNY offshore fixing) to hedge supplier-denominated trade payables
Cross-currency interest rate swap (CCIRS) between EUR and USD aligning trade-finance liabilities with operational cash flows
European-style FX option purchased as contingent hedging (no speculative option-underwriting position without BaFin-appropriate banking mandate)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 12 months after the end of the financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to €5,000 and potential company strike-off after six months of non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Three months after the end of the financial year (extendable by three months)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties and interest charges; repeated non-filing may result in enforcement actions or strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory full audit if the company exceeds two of the following thresholds: annual turnover exceeding €20 million, balance sheet total exceeding €20 million, or more than 250 employees
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: HGB (German Commercial Code) for preparation and presentation of financial statements; tax accounting rules apply for tax filings

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual confirmation required for UBO; beneficial ownership information must be updated in the central register within three months of any change in shareholding or control

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 5,000 - 20,000 USD if full audit is mandated

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15.825% composite federal rate (Körperschaftsteuer 15% plus 5.5% Solidaritätszuschlag on the CIT); plus municipal Gewerbesteuer at unified assessment base with a 245,00 EUR allowance – typical combined aggregate burden 29%–33%,
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: R&D tax credit (Forschungszulage): up to 25% cash refund of qualifying R&D labor/outsourcing costs; partial-income method (95% tax exemption) for qualifying domestic and treaty shelter dividends; degressive depreciation (20% declining balance) for movable fixed assets under § 7(2) EStG; no profit tax for UG statutory reserve differentiations.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited carryforward (no temporal limit) under § 10d(2) EStG; per-assessment-period offset capped at EUR 1,000,000 plus 60% of the excess (minimum taxation); carryback of up to EUR 1,000,000 to the prior year (EUR 500,000 for 2025 assessments).
